<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.1939, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈267.1867 Da. Searching for plausible elemental compositions that match this exact mass, the formula C₁₆H₁₃NO₃ fits best (calculated monoisotopic mass = 267.0895 Da, within typical experimental tolerance) and is consistent with the observed isotopic pattern (no significant halogen pattern). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C16H13NO3.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H13NO3</final_answer>
